# Spacedoc.com

> A comprehensive health and medical research resource covering aging, nutrition, supplements, cancer prevention, and evidence-based wellness information.

Spacedoc.com provides in-depth educational articles on nutritional supplementation, anti-aging research, and disease prevention. The site emphasizes evidence-based information on vitamins, minerals, and medical conditions, featuring contributions from notable researchers and physicians.

## Key Topics

- Anti-aging supplements
- CoQ10
- L-Carnitine
- Vitamin C
- Magnesium
- Selenium
- Alpha-Lipoic Acid
- Mitochondrial health
- Cancer prevention and treatment
- Hormone replacement therapy
- Cardiovascular health
- Nutritional supplementation
- Aging research
- Medical reference
- Health education

## Anti-Aging & Supplement Guides

- [Aging and CoQ10](https://spacedoc.com/articles/aging-and-coq10): Guide to CoQ10 supplementation for anti-aging and cardiovascular health
- [Aging and L-Carnitine](https://spacedoc.com/articles/aging-and-l-carnitine): Guide to L-Carnitine supplementation for aging and mitochondrial health
- [Aging and Vitamin C](https://spacedoc.com/articles/aging-and-vitamin-c): Guide to Vitamin C benefits for aging and health
- [Aging and Magnesium](https://spacedoc.com/articles/aging-and-magnesium): Guide to magnesium supplementation and deficiency prevention
- [Alpha-Lipoic Acid and Aging](https://spacedoc.com/articles/alpha-lipoic-acid-and-aging): Guide to alpha-lipoic acid for cellular energy and antioxidant benefits
- [Aging and Selenium](https://spacedoc.com/articles/aging-and-selenium): Guide to selenium's role in thyroid, immunity, and anti-aging
- [Aging and Vitamins B2 and B3](https://spacedoc.com/articles/vitamins-b2-b3-and-aging): Guide to B vitamins for mitochondrial energy and aging
- [Aging and Lecithin](https://spacedoc.com/articles/aging-and-lecithin): Guide to lecithin phospholipids for health and aging

## Aging & Disease Prevention

- [Aging and Mitochondrial Mutations](https://spacedoc.com/articles/aging-and-mitochondrial-mutations): Article on mitochondrial mutations as cause of natural aging
- [A Recipe for Alzheimer's Disease](https://spacedoc.com/articles/a-recipe-for-alzheimers): Article on Alzheimer's disease risk factors and prevention
- [Asleep at the Wheel - TGA](https://spacedoc.com/articles/asleep-at-the-wheel-tga): Educational guide on transient global amnesia (TGA) and memory loss

## Cancer & Women's Health

- [Hormone Replacement Therapy in Women](https://spacedoc.com/articles/hormone-replacement-therapy): Guide to hormone replacement therapy and progestogen in women
